name: Chickens Be Crazy
storyline: Farmer Fred wakes up to his worst nightmare - his chickens have flown the coop and gone totally bonkers! Your mission? Help Farmer Fred collect the produce scattered across each level to unlock doors and find out what’s driving the chickens mad. Grab your boots and get ready to run, jump, climb, and outwit mischievous other cluckers in a world packed with chaotic fun, brain-bending puzzles, and the occasional “oops, I stepped in something” moment.
summary: The greatest chicken-based, single-screen puzzle platformer of all time (according to me)! Use your skillz to collect produce, outwit crazy chickens, and jetpack through 100 levels of family-friendly fun. Smash bricks, unlock doors, and discover secrets that will keep you coming back for more!
